# Content classes (W2): the markers that tell what a sentence of content is, as
# 'key=value;value' in hex bytes (scripts/hex.sh). 'reference': a word that marks a
# citation, a web address or a reading list. 'speech': a phrase that marks an
# opinion or an address to the reader. 'context': a word a sentence hangs on when
# it opens with it: a pronoun that needs its antecedent, an adverb of place or time,
# a connective; such a sentence is no conception on its own. 'heading': a word that
# is a heading by itself. 'least words' and 'most words': the length of a fact.
